verdict: Organic visibility is your only active lead channel — and it's slipping.
narrative: Across all three locations this period, paid advertising ran at zero spend, meaning every inquiry — directions, calls, and website clicks — came entirely from your Google Business Profile presence. Combined, your locations generated 390 Google Business Profile actions in the last 28 days, which shows a meaningful organic footprint. However, all three locations have seen profile engagement fall in the most recent 7-day stretch, with O'Hare Precision showing a sharp 85% week-over-week drop that points to a listing-level issue rather than normal fluctuation. We are actively investigating that listing now and monitoring the other two locations for the same pattern. Restoring O'Hare Precision's profile visibility is the immediate priority; once resolved, you should see action counts recover toward their prior baseline.
